<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1800027_leve_sys.LeaveApprovalUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LeaveApprovalUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var LeaveApprovalUtils = Class.create();
LeaveApprovalUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    approveLeave: function() {
        try {
            var sysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
            var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1800027_leve_sys_leave_request');
            if (gr.get(sysId)) {
                gr.setWorkflow(false);
                gr.status = 'approved';
                if (gr.update()) {
                    return 'Leave request approved successfully';
                }
                return 'Error: ' + gr.getLastErrorMessage();
            }
            return 'Error: Record not found';
        } catch(ex) {
            return 'Error: ' + ex.message;
        }
    },
    type: 'LeaveApprovalUtils'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-19 13:43:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>c9f24056c336e210a7f1b813e40131ff</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LeaveApprovalUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Leave Management System" source="x_1800027_leve_sys">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Leave Management System">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_c9f24056c336e210a7f1b813e40131ff</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-19 13:46:57</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
